summary: A Riyadh brokerage appears to lose seller and buyer leads to a name mix up, vague calls to action and no proof.

findings.problem: The company appears as Better Real Estate, Better Property and BETTER PROPERTY across the title, logo and footer.
findings.cost: Mixed names confuse owners and hurt search visibility.

findings.problem: The hero buttons appear to be plain labels such as Sell Real Estate, and the closing section Make your dreams a reality appears to have no button or form.
findings.cost: Visitors have no clear next step.
findings.fix: Action buttons and an enquiry form.

findings.problem: The phone link appears to use tel:// and the WhatsApp link appears to include a plus sign, and the address appears with no city.
findings.cost: Mobile visitors may fail to call or message.
findings.fix: Clean call and WhatsApp links and a full address.

findings.problem: No reviews, licence number, team names or listing counts appear, and image files appear to carry stock photo names.
findings.cost: Owners choose a licensed agent they can see and verify.
findings.fix: Licence details, team profiles and reviews.
